sinGLU10 is an application developed by the Asociación de Celíacos y Sensibles al Gluten for those people who, for health reasons, must follow a gluten-free diet.

— More than 5,100 establishments from all over Spain and 600 from other parts of the world, such as restaurants, hotels and stores where you will find gluten-free menus, gluten-free pastries, gluten-free products, etc. Since we also include establishments outside Spain, it will be useful when you travel abroad.

— The classification of food products according to their gluten content and you can quickly find out if the product you are looking for contains, does not contain or may contain gluten.

The more than 20,700 products included have been verified by the Celiac and Gluten Sensitive Association, after consulting the manufacturer and reviewing the relevant certificates, in the same way as the Gluten-Free Products List.

Thanks to the collaboration of the manufacturers, the information is continuously updated and when there is a change, the data in the application is automatically updated, so you will always have it up to date.

It also includes a barcode scanner with which you can quickly and accurately locate the products. The scanned products will be saved in your favorites and if there is a change in them the application will notify you.

— News and Promotions section, with exclusive discounts for App users.

— Gluten-free recipes section, where you will find a hundred gluten-free recipes distributed in different categories that will make your day-to-day life easier.
